scope_note: Finite OpenReview sample used to identify which human review comments are actionable as scientific taste/insight for IGRE gates.

taxonomy.description: Comments indicating that the paper lacks clarity or is difficult to understand.
taxonomy.useful_signal: Indicates areas where the manuscript needs clearer explanations or better organization.
taxonomy.failure_if_ignored: The manuscript may remain confusing, leading to misunderstandings of the research.
example_review_patterns: The clarity is poor and needs improvement.
The paper is difficult to follow.

taxonomy.description: Comments questioning the novelty or significance of the proposed method.
taxonomy.useful_signal: Highlights whether the research direction is worth pursuing or if it overlaps significantly with existing work.
taxonomy.failure_if_ignored: The research may not contribute new knowledge or advancements in the field.
example_review_patterns: The approach seems similar to existing methods.
The novelty of the contribution is questionable.

taxonomy.description: Comments that point out specific limitations or weaknesses in the methodology or results.
taxonomy.useful_signal: Identifies areas where the claims made in the paper may be overstated or unsupported.
taxonomy.failure_if_ignored: The paper may present misleading conclusions or fail to address critical flaws.
example_review_patterns: The limitations of the method are not adequately discussed.
There are significant weaknesses in the experimental design.

taxonomy.description: Comments that critique the metrics used for evaluation or suggest missing baselines.
taxonomy.useful_signal: Indicates potential weaknesses in the evaluation framework that could undermine the results.
taxonomy.failure_if_ignored: The evaluation may not accurately reflect the performance of the proposed method.
example_review_patterns: The evaluation metrics are not appropriate for this task.
Missing baseline comparisons weaken the results.

taxonomy.description: Comments that provide constructive feedback on how to improve the manuscript.
taxonomy.useful_signal: Offers actionable suggestions that can enhance the clarity and quality of the manuscript.
taxonomy.failure_if_ignored: The manuscript may not reach its full potential and could be less impactful.
example_review_patterns: Consider revising the introduction for better context.
The results section could benefit from clearer explanations.

workflow_rules.rule: Prioritize addressing clarity issues in the manuscript.
workflow_rules.rationale: Improving clarity enhances the overall understanding and impact of the research.

workflow_rules.rule: Ensure that limitations are clearly stated and discussed.
workflow_rules.rationale: Acknowledging limitations strengthens the credibility of the research and helps set realistic expectations.

taxonomy.claim_boundary: Claims made in the paper should be supported by robust evidence and clearly articulated limitations to avoid overstating the contributions.
